hypothesis: Exact ordered MediaWiki template skeletons reused across chronological pages displace at least 3000 bytes per raw MB of endpoint428 arithmetic work and retain at least 2100 B/M after transmitting WRT rule definitions, invocation descriptors, framing, and measured source while preserving the original parent truth-update trajectory.
interfaces_exposed: GEN_RULE emits exact transmitted WRT skeleton segments with literal holes, omits generated truth bits from the residual arithmetic payload, and replays every generated bit through the unchanged parent state trajectory.
kill_condition: If the uncharged exact repeated-skeleton ceiling is below 3000 B/M, retire ordered-template surface LOGOS immediately. If the paid archive misses any economic or identity gate, retire this rule/invocation format. Do not sweep occurrence thresholds, hole counts, rule widths, integer codes, or template nesting; do not infer that untested semantic LOGOS or NOEMA is retired.
promotion_condition: At exact opening 1M, the uncharged repeated-skeleton parent-codelength ceiling is at least 3000 B/M; the constructed state-preserving grammar archive saves at least 3000 B/M gross and projects at least 2100 B/M after measured source; development, selection, and sealed confirmation are positive; parent payload, command, WRT, raw inverse, and second-archive identities all pass. A pass authorizes semantic-rule discovery, not native or 10M integration.
rejection_reason: The exact opening-1M retry mapped 443 ordered templates and found 18 WRT skeleton keys repeated at least twice in development, covering 201 legal occurrences and 2,209 generated WRT bytes. Even with zero command, definition, framing, and source charge, the actual terminated residual payload saved only 291 bytes (291 B/M), below one tenth of the frozen 3,000 B/M ceiling. Paid selection retained zero rules and zero invocations; S1 was 173,923 bytes versus the 173,896-byte parent (-27 B/M gross, -42.496 B/M after measured source). Parent payload, control, WRT, raw inverse, and deterministic archive proofs passed. Retire ordered-template surface LOGOS without rescue sweeps; semantic LOGOS and NOEMA remain untested.
retired_neighborhoods: Global WikiIR/LZMA ordered-template serialization and single-prior-page Route E copies; this candidate measures shared WRT rules directly against endpoint428 and does not transform the parent update sequence.
